description:
Magnesium Gummies for Kids above 4 years

Some days, kids are extra cranky, restless, or just can't seem to settle down at bedtime. And as parents, it's hard not to wonder: "Are they getting everything they need?"

Magnesium is an important mineral that plays an important role in muscle and nerve function. Since many kids can be picky eaters, getting enough through everyday foods isn't always easy.

Signs your child may not be getting enough magnesium:

• Restless or uneasy sleep

• Fussiness or cranky moods

• Muscle discomfort after active play

• Low intake of nuts, seeds, greens, or whole foods

Little Joys Magnesium Gummies are thoughtfully made for busy families who want something clean, simple, and easy to say yes to.

🌿 19 mg elemental magnesium for normal muscle and nerve function, along with Vitamin B6 & Vegan D3

🌾 Made with fibre (prebiotic from chicory root)

🚫 ZERO Added Sugar

🎨 No artificial colours, flavours, or preservatives

30 Gummies | Clean Label | Approved by Moms. Loved by Kids.

Chew 1 gummy once daily after a meal.

Take at a consistent time of day.

Close the jar tightly: keep in a cool, dry place (≤25°C).
